name: Washi Tape
description: Strips of translucent washi tape with torn zigzag ends crisscrossing the sheet, some plain and some printed with stripes, dots or a check.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { -webkit-transform: translate(@r(-12, 12)%, @r(-12, 12)%) rotate(@calc(@rn(-70, 70, 1.3) + @p(-90, 0, 0))deg); transform: translate(@r(-12, 12)%, @r(-12, 12)%) rotate(@calc(@rn(-70, 70, 1.3) + @p(-90, 0, 0))deg); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -25%; width: 150%; top: 30%; height: 40%; background: @p(@var(--stripes), @var(--dots), @var(--check), none), @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); opacity: 0.82; -webkit-clip-path: @var(--tape); clip-path: @var(--tape); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --tape: polygon(0% 0%, 3% 12.5%, 0% 25%, 3% 37.5%, 0% 50%, 3% 62.5%, 0% 75%, 3% 87.5%, 0% 100%, 100% 100%, 97% 87.5%, 100% 75%, 97% 62.5%, 100% 50%, 97% 37.5%, 100% 25%, 97% 12.5%, 100% 0%); --stripes: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 4%, var(--color1) 4% 6%); --dots: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, var(--color1) 0 18%, transparent 18%) 0 0 / 7% 25%; --check: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 3%, var(--color1) 3% 6%), repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 12.5%, var(--color1) 12.5% 25%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
